lines.en: Sara and I make plans over the phone to spend some time together in the city.
lines.zh: Sara 和我在电话里说好，去城里一起待一段时间。

lines.en: We meet in front of the same headquarters as our first 'date,' which has become sort of a landmark to us, and proceed to wander around the town looking for a place to get her boba tea.
lines.zh: 我们约在第一次「约会」时那栋总部大楼前碰面——那儿对我们来说已经有点像地标了——然后开始在城里转悠，找地方给她买珍珠奶茶。

lines.en: I want to say I'm surprised at how [young]Sara acts despite having a [teenage]daughter, but I don't think anything about her would {i}really{/i} surprise me at this point.
lines.zh: 我本想说我惊讶于 Sara 明明有个[十几岁]的女儿，举止却这么[年轻]，但到了这一步，她身上大概没什么能{i}真的{/i}让我惊讶了。

lines.en: She's like a [teenage]girl trapped in an attractive mother's body...which might actually explain why I like hanging out with her as much as I do.
lines.zh: 她就像一个困在迷人母亲身体里的[十几岁]女孩……这大概正好解释了我为什么这么喜欢跟她待在一起。

lines.en: Sara winds up spotting some tea-shop she's never seen before and forces me inside of it.
lines.zh: Sara 后来发现了一家她从没见过的奶茶店，硬把我拉了进去。

lines.en: She then {i}pretends{/i} to forget her wallet and I have to pay for her.
lines.zh: 接着她{i}假装{/i}忘了带钱包，只好由我付钱。

lines.en: Things like this would piss me off coming from most people, but something about the way Sara does it makes it seem less malicious and more...endearing.
lines.zh: 这种事换成大多数人做，我大概会火大，但 Sara 做起来就是没那么有恶意，反而……有点可爱。

lines.en: And so I buy her her stupid boba tea and the two of us walk around for another hour or so before heading home...
lines.zh: 于是我给她买了那杯破珍珠奶茶，我俩又逛了一个来小时才回家……
